campaign.name: Aff(F_q) at prime powers and q=13: AGL(1,q) 2BGA feasibility spike
campaign.hypothesis: n=2q(q-1) bands at q=13 (n=312, existing metacyclic path) and q=16 (n=480, AGL(1,16) = C_2^4 |x C_15 via a perm_group Cayley adapter -- F_16^+ is not cyclic so metacyclic does not apply) are unmined on the board. A 480-16-60-class point (eff 120) would land between the 544 and 684 anchors on the eff frontier.

bar.note: feasibility spike: any non-dominated board_advancing point at n 312/480 pays for the adapter

campaign.method: q=13: kasai_affine_sweep --q-min 13 --q-max 13. q=16: write research/kit AGL(1,16) Cayley adapter (perm_group over F_16 affine maps, ~30 lines), verify against known group order 16*15=240, then build_2bga draws; screen fast; deep ladder on any screen >= board bar
campaign.what_a_negative_would_teach: Whether the metacyclic family's efficiency is specific to the prime-field bands or generalizes to prime powers.
